summary: New ambient traffic group (mode 3, own MultiMesh, path-style Bezier shader motion, dimmer hull and shorter streak via amb_gain/amb_streak). map._update_ambient_traffic registers one lane per planet pair of the viewed system from the start (no condition), arc shared with route_line (GAP, BOW, sun waypoint), count split by 1/length with traffic_ambient_min each; rewritten only when planets, positions, sizes or numbers change. Debug stats and draw calls include the group. New keys traffic_ambient_ships 1000 (owner number) and placeholders traffic_ambient_min/scale/speed/streak/bright. No save fields, no text. Quick look screenshot: logs/screenshots/T303.png (far zoom, no breakage; layer is faded out at far zoom by design).
